title: NJPW vs. UWFI: Muto, Takada & Hashimoto
summary: Nobuhiko Takada challenges New Japan on behalf of UWFI. Keiji Muto wins the first Dome confrontation, but Takada takes the title in the rematch, leaving Shinya Hashimoto to bring it back.

chapters.title: Muto wins the first Dome battle
chapters.result: Muto submits Takada to retain the IWGP heavyweight title.
chapters.context: The main event gives New Japan the central victory in a card built around promotional rivalry.

chapters.title: Takada takes the championship
chapters.result: Takada defeats Muto for the IWGP title.
chapters.context: UWFI’s representative reverses the October result and carries New Japan’s leading championship into the opposing camp.

chapters.title: Hashimoto restores New Japan’s pride
chapters.result: Hashimoto defeats Takada to regain the title for NJPW.
chapters.context: The victory resolves the central title struggle and establishes Hashimoto as the company’s leading champion.
